thread:
Priya (Support): Escalating: NimbusPay onboarding blocked after SAML metadata update; SSO fails and downstream embedding jobs error 422. Renewal in ~9 days. Tagging @Sam @Maya.

Sam (CS): Got it. Share org id + error snippets so we can assess renewal risk.

Priya (Support): Org: nimbuspay-live. Logs: 
2026-03-22T09:12:03Z ERROR req=xyz-77 auth=saml status=401 msg="saml: invalid assertion: audience mismatch"
2026-03-22T09:13:10Z ERROR req=xyz-78 embed_job=ej_443 status=422 msg="embedding failed record_id=rec_204"

Maya (CSM): I'll own customer comms. Need ETA and who's joining the call.

Leo (SE): Likely our SSO cache didn't reload. Quick fixes: rollout restart auth-service + provisioner, or add a short-lived allowlist flag `sso.allowlist.nimbuspay-live`.

Tanya (Security): We'll need IdP fingerprint before allowlisting. Approve temporary allowlist with approval recorded.

Priya (Support): Incident INC-2026-202 opened. (IncidentBot created).

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-202 created by Priya (Support). Priority: P1.

Sam (CS): Comms plan: Maya sends initial email in 30m offering (1) guided config reload with SE or (2) temporary allowlist after fingerprint verification. ETA mitigation 60-90m. Flag renewals owner after incident.

Maya (CSM): Draft email posted for review. Will schedule a 10:30 PT call.

Priya (Support): Customer DM'd IdP fingerprint. Passing to Tanya.

Tanya (Security): Fingerprint received. Approve allowlist for 8 hours; documenting approval in the ticket.

Leo (SE): Flipped allowlist flag and restarted auth-service. Watching metrics; 401s dropped to zero.

Priya (Support): Confirming provisioning resumed and embed jobs re-queued. Customer progress reported.

Maya (CSM): Sent update to customer, scheduled follow-up with renewals owner.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-202 marked RESOLVED by Leo (SE). Postmortem pending.

Sam (CS): After closure: action items for Product/Platform: metadata-change alerts, rotation validation, and onboarding checklist update.

Maya (CSM): Closing loop with customer; renewal owner notified.
